desc: We are excited to announce the launch of the Micro Compact holster. Designed to fit the top selling micro carry guns including the Glock 42 and 43x, Sig 365x/XL, Springfield Hellcat, and many more. Compatible with most optics, this holster will be offered in both concealable and outside-waist configurations. All Stealth Operator holsters are injection molded for maximum toughness and strength, while also allowing a very thin/low-print construction. Stealth Operator is proudly 100% made in the USA and carries a limited lifetime warranty.
